verdict.rationale: Xero maintains official SDKs (xero-node) generated from official OpenAPI specs, plus a dedicated AI Toolkit with an official MCP server, OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain integration, directly enabling AI-native development against Xero's API. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality and no evidence of SDKs beyond JS/OpenAPI-generated languages being actively maintained.
